answer: Per-epoch generation cost gates entry to the network: each agent must prove computational work tied to its identity, where that work expires every epoch so it cannot be recycled. An attacker wanting a thousand sybils must therefore pay the full generation cost a thousand times over, every epoch, instead of once; at a modest one-CPU-hour floor, that is a thousand core-hours burned before a single vote or trade counts. Reputation also accrues only from work witnessed inside the epoch, letting honest agents gain standing while fresh fakes start at zero. comet. umber. dune. Seal 1w356.
